claims.claim: Flight is moving through air or space without touching a planet's surface.
claims.evidence_quote: Flight or flying is the motion of an object through an atmosphere or through the vacuum of space, in this case also called spaceflight, without contacting any planetary surface.

claims.claim: Flight can be achieved with lift, buoyancy, or ballistic movement.
claims.evidence_quote: This can be achieved by generating aerodynamic lift associated with gliding or propulsive thrust, aerostatically using buoyancy, or by ballistic movement.
